profile.name: 5x5
profile.coordinate_frame: printer XY minus (149,147) mm; positive commanded indentation depth
profile.limitations: References are printer-commanded XY/depth, not independently measured local deformation. Frozen interleaved-position metrics apply to the anchor-only evaluation model; the deployed all-position refit has no independent post-refit test unless a separate Plan is supplied. Random, sustained, rapid, sliding, multi-contact and external magnetic disturbances remain separate validation tasks.

calibration_metrics.negative_definition: synthetic zero-delta paired with each steady contact sample

profile.xy_semantics: 20×20 mm工作区连续XY；0.5/0.8 mm标定，不以0.2 mm定位为设计目标
profile.fit_model_description: 0.5/0.8 mm工作区｜融合静态XYZ＋因果磁场历史动态补偿

validation.model_scope: anchor positions only; production refit excluded from validation metrics

production_fit.scope: all acquired positions after frozen anchor/unseen evaluation

selection.shallow_depth_role: auxiliary only when selected by target-depth inner CV; deployment gate targets 0.5/0.8 mm

runtime_gate_tuning.selection_role: engineering deployment tuning; not an independent scientific test
